text: So...this is what you get when a tech billionaire living in Shanghai China with deep CCP connections funds a bunch of "activist" groups around immigration laws that have; A. been on the books for generations, B. have been stringently enforced by several Democrat administrations over a couple generations, and C. whips these "activists" into a frenzy, thusly bringing the kind of chaos that leads to incidents like this. This group very deliberately brought the amplitude of this up to a level where officers finally decided they needed to act, got into an altercation with a moving vehicle aimed at them (and yes, he was struck, which is when his weapon discharged)....and the result was street chaos and someone getting shot. This incident didn't spring out of the ether, it was deliberately brought to a boil. The handlers of this movement got precisely what they were looking for...spectacle involving the security forces of the target nation. Standard internal disruption tactics. This is what they paid some millions for. But no matter, this CCP funded movement will cry foul, go even further into a frenzy, and continue to engage in these sorts of disruption tactics. Will be interesting to see who they were seeking. This wasn't a random sweep, and I'll just bet that the individual in question was released by local law enforcement despite a retainer request....which now they have to take it to the streets, where chaos is sooner or later going to happen, and now someone has been shot. This was the set up they've been waiting for.
